# Minneapolis Community & Technical College

> > Minneapolis Community & Technical College (Minneapolis College) is a comprehensive community and technical college offering career training, continuing education, and degree programs in the arts, health sciences, and technical fields.

The college serves over 6,000 students with programs ranging from Addiction Counseling and Sleep Technology to Graphic Design and Pharmacy Technology. Campus facilities include the Technical Building, Whitney Fine Arts Center, and newly expanded parking structures.

- [Outstanding Educators of the Year Announced](https://minneapolis.edu/news/outstanding-educators-year-announced): Bergin, Ortiz, and Sippel named 2021-2022 Outstanding Educators
